question: In a certain code language, 'FURNACE' is written as 'EVQOZDD'. How will 'IMAGERY' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/WTkfIfsPOgfRBrecdIRDf1cjM89loSSR3EyltndMJbh82FnD9-8GHpkUw3LRu0qfNkXkq0ecDTTwKkzNWyHb_J0N-adPqR_9NGdGW_4BUn7889dTwDUlANyoj975xdEa8tK3RK9xZkhx6k68b_7Nk_7rBEZNeoIN2YdfF3OqEs34ob7X1zQq8uzP7Zh9] 

'FURNACE' is written as 'EVQOZDD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5efb9c3ce21469df4c6b39f15fa8fd615fa7fb3b8384577b53a9e98bcf9b59.png] 

Similarly,

'IMAGERY' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9ba67418cd3928022017ccf172ad70f8e5844eadb503cdf335dc1de2ac61174.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HNZHDSX".**
